claims.statement: For every homogeneous arity-2 path-star profile with m>=1, N=2m, Q=(1+3z+z^2)^m, C=(1+2z)Q, E=z(1+z)^(2m), the shifted E minor M_k(E)=E[k]C[k]-E[k+1]C[k-1] is strictly positive at the outermost guarded rank k=m+1, with M_(m+1)(E)/binom(2m,m)=((m+2)Q[m]-(m-1)Q[m-1])/(m+1)>0. This is only a component/rank lemma, not the full selector payment.
claims.scope: Homogeneous arity-2 profiles only, at k=m+1 in the guard 2k<=N+2. No actual first-descent or deletion-selector premise is used; no conclusion covers other guarded ranks, mixed arities, original-tag aggregation, or the primary payment.
claims.reason: Palindromicity and positive-interval log-concavity of Q imply Q[m]>=Q[m-1]>0; direct substitution of the binomial coefficients and C coefficients gives the exact expression, whose numerator is 3Q[m]+(m-1)(Q[m]-Q[m-1])>0.

limitations: The packet has no additional worker-case sources; all 275 common-manifest members were hash-verified.
No universal proof or realizable counterexample for the exact-ratio primary payment was found.
No finite census, formal verification, or source-program execution was performed; the partial arity-2 lemma does not replace any full-base requirement.
